info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Delete Weather Alerts Unsubscribe-v2-spec
info.description: The Weather Alerts Unsubscription API allows users to unsubscribe from weather alerts, ensuring they do not receive unwanted notifications. This operation is designed for both individual users and organizations who may wish to manage their alert preferences effectively. By utilizing this API, consumers can streamline their alert subscriptions based on changing needs or preferences. The API is particularly useful for developers integrating weather alert management into their applications, providing a seamless user experience.

delete.description: This endpoint allows users to unsubscribe from receiving alerts. It will remove the user's subscription and stop any future notifications related to alerts.

requestBody.description: A request to unsubscribe from alerts. This operation removes the user's subscription to specific alerts, ensuring they no longer receive notifications.

DeleteWeatherAlertsUnsubscribeRequest.description: The request body for unsubscribing from alerts. This expects a string value that may contain relevant unsubscribe information.

DeleteWeatherAlertsUnsubscribeResponse_2.title: Unsubscribe Operations Response

status.description: Indicates if the unsubscribe operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for the unsubscribe request.

resultId.description: The ID of the result record pertaining to the unsubscribe operation.

state.description: The current state of the unsubscribe operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The total time taken to process the unsubscribe request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the unsubscribe operation.

audit.description: Information related to the audit of the unsubscribe operation.

DeleteWeatherAlertsUnsubscribeResponse_2.description: This schema represents the response structure for the unsubscribe operation via a DELETE request.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: Identifier of the user or system that created the audit entry.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the audit entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the request was processed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: This schema represents the audit information related to the unsubscribe operation.

x-processing-time.description: The time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds. A lower value indicates faster processing.
